results.note: As of 2026-10-12 the 180-day lockup has not expired yet. Class-action notices give 2026-10-13, while MarketBeat lists 10-14. Searches found no announced post-expiry secondary. Shares were already weak before the expiry, trading as low as $14.06 per MarketBeat on 2026-10-07. The lead-plaintiff deadline of 2026-10-20 is unchanged (MarketBeat / Kaplan Fox notices).

The interim milestone closed on time and favorably. KDP's 8-K (SEC, filed 2026-09-28) says the Chobani deals completed on 2026-09-28: the $800M stake redemption ($400M cash plus a $400M note due 2026-12-26) and the $125M Allentown facility sale, with net proceeds going to debt reduction. The board catalyst, the separation into Beverage Co / Global Coffee Co, is still ahead: Q3-26 earnings in late Oct 2026, operational readiness at year-end 2026, and the split in early 2027.

As of 2026-10-12, NOAA's virtual hearing (Federal Register 2026-16869, docket NOAA-NOS-2026-1751) is still set for 13-Oct and comments close 19-Oct. I found no report of a postponement, and the hearing is a procedural step, not a decision. The board's permit date is stale and leans adverse: on its Q2 call (2026-08-13), TMC said certification is now expected in Oct-2026 and a Q1-2027 permit is no longer likely, only one before Q4-2027 vessel commissioning, so the board's "end-Q1-2027" decision target should be pushed out.
